getting-around.title: Getting Around Ghana
getting-around.content:
Domestic Flights

PassionAir and Africa World Airlines (AWA) fly daily between Accra (ACC), Kumasi (KMS), Tamale (TML), and Takoradi (TKD).

Ride Hailing & Taxis

Uber, Yango, and Bolt operate extensively throughout Greater Accra and Kumasi. Local orange-fender taxis are also widely available.

Tro-Tros & Intercity Coaches

Tro-tros (shared minibuses) are the quintessential Ghanaian commute. For long distances, VIP Jeoun and STC offer comfortable air-conditioned coaches.

flight-visa.title: Flight & Visa Requirements
flight-visa.content:
Visa on Arrival & E-Visa

Ghana offers online e-Visa applications and Visa on Arrival for ECOWAS citizens, African Union passport holders, and during December in GH season.

Major Airlines Serving Accra (ACC)

Kotoka International Airport is served by Delta, British Airways, Emirates, KLM, Qatar Airways, Ethiopian Airlines, and Turkish Airlines.

Yellow Fever Certificate

A valid international yellow fever vaccination card is mandatory for all incoming travelers over 9 months of age.

practical-info.title: Practical Information & Tips
practical-info.content:
Currency & Mobile Money (MoMo)

The currency is the Ghana Cedi (GHS). Mobile Money (MTN MoMo) and cards are used everywhere in cities, but carry cash when visiting rural areas.

Language & Greetings

English is the official language. Learning basic Twi greetings like Akwaaba (Welcome), Eti sen? (How are you?), and Medaase (Thank you) will warm every heart!

Power & Adapters

Ghana uses Type G 3-pin British plugs (230V, 50Hz). Pack a universal travel adapter and power bank for safari trips.
